tagline: Driving sustainable organic growth through Iron + Tech strategy combining industrial equipment with advanced technology integration
hero_kpi_rationale: Core company strategy combining industrial equipment (Iron) and technology integration (Tech), particularly in precision agriculture, automation, connectivity, and autonomy.

kpis.name: Product and Technology Strategy
kpis.explanation: Strategy focused on integrating advanced technologies (precision, automation, connectivity) into agricultural and construction equipment.
kpis.description: The 'Iron + Tech' strategy aims to differentiate products through automation, connectivity, and autonomy, particularly in precision agriculture.
kpis.signal: Key positioning on technological innovation within a traditional industrial sector

kpis.name: Revenue
kpis.explanation: Total revenue generated from industrial and financial activities.
kpis.description: Combined revenue from agricultural equipment, construction, and financial services segments.
kpis.signal: Consolidated revenue reflecting the company's overall performance

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.description: Measures operating performance after cost of goods sold and overhead expenses.

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures
kpis.explanation: Spending on fixed assets to maintain or expand operational capacity.
kpis.description: Capex directed toward factories, equipment, and technological innovations.
kpis.signal: Commitment to productive and technological capabilities

kpis.name: Total Headcount
kpis.description: Workforce distributed across industrial, commercial, and financial activities.

kpis.name: Finance Receivables
kpis.explanation: Total amount of receivables from financing activities exposed to default risk.
kpis.description: Finance receivables amounted to $23.105 billion at the end of 2025, compared to $23.085 billion at the end of 2024.

kpis.name: Past Due or Non-Accrual Receivables
kpis.explanation: Amount of receivables past due or classified as non-accrual within the financing portfolio.
kpis.description: Past due or non-accrual receivables increased from $235 million to $430 million between 2024 and 2025, reflecting a deterioration in borrower portfolios.
kpis.signal: Significant increase in deteriorating credit quality

kpis.name: Currency Risk Exposure
kpis.explanation: Portion of net business flows exposed to exchange rate fluctuations.
kpis.description: 19% of net revenues exposed to currency risk in 2025, down from 20% in 2024. Key exposures include EUR/USD, USD/BRL, EUR/BRL, AUD/USD, USD/INR, and EUR/GBP.
kpis.signal: Slight decrease in currency risk exposure

risks.title: Economic Environment
risks.score_rationale: 8.8% decline in revenue in 2025 compared to 2024, primarily due to lower demand in the agricultural industry

risks.title: Competition
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in a competitive market with established players and new entrants, which may pressure pricing and market share

risks.title: Environmental and Trade Regulation
risks.score_rationale: Changes in trade and environmental regulations may impact company operations and costs

risks.title: Dependence on Agricultural Industry
risks.score_rationale: The company is highly dependent on the agricultural industry, making it vulnerable to fluctuations in demand and pricing

risks.title: Credit Risk and Asset Quality
risks.score_rationale: 83% increase in past due or non-accrual receivables, rising from $235 million to $430 million between 2024 and 2025, exposing the company to potential losses

risks.title: Innovation and Technology Development
risks.score_rationale: The company must invest in research and development to maintain competitiveness and meet evolving customer needs
